spl:
index=database sourcetype="clickhouse:replicas"
| eval q=tonumber(queue_size)
| where q > 500 OR is_readonly==1 OR is_readonly=="true"
| stats max(q) as max_queue latest(absolute_delay) as abs_delay_sec by database, table, host
| sort -max_queue
description: Alerts on 'ClickHouse ReplicatedMergeTree Replica Read-Only Mode and Absolute Delay' patterns (UC-7.1.56) sourced from `index=database` sourcetype `clickhouse:replicas`. Threshold bundle: configured threshold; aggregation grain: `database`, `table`, `host`; metrics: `max_queue`. Watch terms: ClickHouse, ReplicatedMergeTree, Replica, Read, Only.
value: UC-7.1.56 gives Operations teams earlier visibility into Absolute Delay through `clickhouse:replicas` feeds, lowering operational risk and delayed incident response.
implementation: Poll `SELECT database, table, queue_size, absolute_delay, is_readonly FROM system.replicas` on each node every 60s. Normalize booleans. Alert queue_size >1000 (tune per table size) or sustained growth over 30 minutes. Correlate with `clickhouse:server_log` ZooKeeper errors.
visualization: Line chart (queue_size by table), Single value (max queue), Table (database, table, host, is_readonly).

detailedImplementation:
Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Scheduled SQL to Splunk via HEC exporting `system.replicas` columns — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=clickhouse:replicas into database. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`database, host, table`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
